analysis_cirs.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Single Switch Forward DC-DC Converter
* Auto-grounded net 2 due to VIN:-
* Created internal net n8 for RSN_P:neg -> CSN_P:pos
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=39 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.1 Cjo=1e-11 Tt=1.5e-08 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
.subckt Xfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e6 Cww=0
Rwp  P1  P1a {Rwp}
Rws  S1  S1a {Rws}
Lp   P1a P2  {Lm}
Ls   S1a S2  {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1   Lp  Ls  {K}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww  P1a S1a {Cww}
.ends Xfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 PWL(0 0 0.003 48)
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.1
VPWM1 n_PWM1_int 0 PULSE(0 12 0 1e-07 1e-07 4.1e-06 1e-05)
RPWM1_drive n_PWM1_int n3 100
VSW1_SENSE n1 n_SW1_dsense 0
MSW1 n_SW1_dsense n3 0 0 nmos_model
VT1_SENSE_PRI n0 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC n4 n_T1_s1_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n1 n_T1_s1_sense n6 Xfmr Lm=0.0005 Ns=2.5 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e+06 Cww=0
RSN_P n1 n8 100
CSN_P n8 n0 1e-08
R_ISO n6 0 1e+08
VD_FWD_SENSE n4 n_D_FWD_sense 0
RD_FWD_SENSE_DAMP n_D_FWD_sense n_D_FWD_damp 0.001
D_FWD n_D_FWD_damp n5 Dmodel
VD_FW_SENSE n6 n_D_FW_sense 0
RD_FW_SENSE_DAMP n_D_FW_sense n_D_FW_damp 0.001
D_FW n_D_FW_damp n5 Dmodel
VL_OUT_SENSE n5 n_L_OUT_sense 0
RL_OUT_ESR n_L_OUT_sense n_L_OUT_ser 0.05
L_OUT n_L_OUT_ser n7 0.0001 IC=0
CL_OUT_par n5 n7 3e-11
RL_OUT_core n5 n7 1e+06
VCout_SENSE n7 n_Cout_sense 0
LCout_ESL n_Cout_sense n_Cout_esl 1e-10
RCout_ESR n_Cout_esl n_Cout_esr 0.02
Cout n_Cout_esr n6 0.00047 IC=0
RCout_LEAK n7 n6 1.6e+07
VR_LOAD_SENSE n7 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
LR_LOAD_PL n_R_LOAD_sense n_R_LOAD_mid 1e-08
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_mid n6 5

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc
